description: Global Roads Inventory Project (GRIP) - PBL 2018 is a dataset listed in Dutch national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by DONL Dataregister. The Global Roads Inventory Project (GRIP) consists of a global vector dataset and derived road density raster datasets. Coverage: the Netherlands. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC0-1.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-nl-portal.
